title: Arrest made in case of racist graffiti at NH coffee shop
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Local News Police arrested a 20-year-old Allenstown, New Hampshire, man after an investigation into the vandalism of a downtown Manchester coffee shop.
New Hampshire police have arrested a 20-year-old man in connection with the vandalism of a downtown Manchester coffee shop that was targeted with white supremacist graffiti last week.
Tyler Inman, of Allenstown, New Hampshire, was arrested Wednesday night and charged with criminal mischief and falsifying evidence, Manchester police announced.
